command:
set +e
# spawn runs task commands under bash -e; `set -uo pipefail` does not clear it (spawn#707).
set -uo pipefail
cd /tmp
printf 'e134dfb113e9fa3848e9d7b4052133dd508fe30b9cb06b9db94ac57f88d38a0a  fetch.py\nd1e4bf8915ce3551c0114bae44f59c67ae66cfdcee702b767fb65f5c5e268192  qasmbench-357b942.gitblobs\n' > scripts.sha256
sha256sum -c scripts.sha256 || { echo 'FAIL: a staged script does not match its pin'; exit 1; }
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH TMPDIR=/tmp
mkdir -p /tmp/out
python3 -u fetch.py qasmbench-357b942.gitblobs /tmp/out || { echo 'FAIL: fetch'; exit 1; }
find /tmp/out -type f | wc -l
du -sh /tmp/out
echo DONE
